present.label: Read the input
present.story: The shelf is sorted from cheapest to most expensive. We need two different books that total exactly {target}.
present.formal: prices has {n} values in nondecreasing order. Find indices i < j with prices[i] + prices[j] = {target}.

initialize:normal.label: Start at both ends
initialize:normal.story: Point at the cheapest book (position {left}) and the most expensive (position {right}). Every possible answer is still between them.
initialize:normal.formal: left = {left}, right = {right}. Invariant: any answer lies within [left, right].

initialize:too-few.label: Start at both ends
initialize:too-few.story: There are only {n} books on the shelf, so two different books cannot be chosen.
initialize:too-few.formal: n = {n} < 2, so the loop condition left < right is false from the start.

compare-sum:less.label: Compare
compare-sum:less.story: {leftValue} + {rightValue} = {sum}, less than {target}. Even the most expensive book left cannot lift the {leftValue}-unit book to the voucher.
compare-sum:less.formal: prices[{left}] + prices[{right}] = {sum} < {target}. prices[{right}] is the largest remaining value, so index {left} is in no answer.

compare-sum:greater.label: Compare
compare-sum:greater.story: {leftValue} + {rightValue} = {sum}, more than {target}. Even the cheapest book left makes the {rightValue}-unit book too expensive.
compare-sum:greater.formal: prices[{left}] + prices[{right}] = {sum} > {target}. prices[{left}] is the smallest remaining value, so index {right} is in no answer.

move-left.label: Move left inward
move-left.story: Rule out the {droppedValue}-unit book. The left pointer moves to position {to}, a {newValue}-unit book.
move-left.formal: left: {from} → {to}. Index {from} is excluded and the invariant still holds.

move-right.label: Move right inward
move-right.story: Rule out the {droppedValue}-unit book. The right pointer moves to position {to}, a {newValue}-unit book.
move-right.formal: right: {from} → {to}. Index {from} is excluded and the invariant still holds.

found.label: Return the answer
found.story: Buy the books at positions {left} and {right}: {leftValue} + {rightValue} = {target}.

not-found.label: No pair
not-found.story: The pointers have met. No two different books add up to {target}.
not-found.formal: left ≥ right, so fewer than two candidates remain. Return null.

present.label: Read the input
present.story: We need two different books that total exactly {target}. This approach ignores the order and tries every pair.
present.formal: prices has {n} values. Try every pair i < j until prices[i] + prices[j] = {target}.

pick-first.label: Choose the first book
pick-first.story: Take the {value}-unit book at position {i} as the first book. Books after it to try: {partners}.
pick-first.formal: Outer loop: i = {i}. The inner loop tries every j from i + 1 to n − 1 ({partners} pairs).

compare-pair:miss.label: Try a pair
compare-pair:miss.story: {firstValue} + {secondValue} = {sum}. Not {target}, so try the next book.

found.label: Return the answer
found.story: Buy the books at positions {i} and {j}: {firstValue} + {secondValue} = {target}.

not-found.label: No pair
not-found.story: All {pairs} pairs were tried and none adds up to {target}.
